Name: Craftable and Functional Wishing Well
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
[size=3][size=4]About[/size]

If you find yourself saying "Wells are nice to have, but they take up so much space and are so inconvenient to build", then this mod is for you! It adds a compact, craftable wishing well to the game. You can refill your watering can at it and toss a coin in it once per day to make a wish!

The wishing well recipe is known by default. You can craft one with 10 wood and 20 stone.

Source available on [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/Functional%20Wishing%20Well]GitHub[/url].

[size=4]FAQ[/size]

Q: What happens when I toss a coin into the well?
A: That's a secret! Maybe if you wish hard enough, your wish will come true... [spoiler]Ok, fine! You'll notice a little bonus content in your mailbox at 10, 20, 30, 50, 70, and 100 coins tossed in the well after you've also received the letter from the hat mouse :)[/spoiler]

[size=4]Permissions[/size]

You may create and publish recolors, etc. for the wishing well art in this mod as long as you credit me by linking back to this mod page in your description. Please read the permission tab for further details.
